milestones.title: Milestone A: PolkaVM Smart Contract Escrow & Ricardian Architecture
milestones.description: Historical PolkaVM contract, Ricardian, indexer, SDK, and readiness work. This milestone is complete and retained for traceability. Active production-readiness work is governed by the Base-era M0-M5 milestones and the Cotsel Production Readiness programme.

milestones.title: Milestone B: Non-Custodial Integration & Hybrid Split Settlement
milestones.description: Historical non-custodial and hybrid settlement integration work. This milestone is complete and retained for traceability. Active settlement remediation and evidence work is governed by the Base-era M0-M5 milestones and the Cotsel Production Readiness programme.

milestones.title: Milestone C: Pilot with 1 Buyer + 1 Cooperative & Enforceability Memo
milestones.description: Historical pilot-planning and evidence work. This milestone is complete and does not authorize the current controlled pilot. Current pilot authorization is governed by WP-0 through WP-11 and release-specific E-0 through E-5 and P-0 through P-6 gates.

milestones.title: Needs Triage
milestones.description:
Temporary routing milestone for open pull requests and issues that cannot be mapped at intake.

An owner must route each item to M0-M5 or record why it remains in triage.

milestones.title: M0 Base Migration Decision and Boundary Freeze
milestones.description: WP-0 release scope and authority baseline: pilot boundary, system-of-record ownership, release and evidence identity, cloud decision, provider boundaries, RACI, risk acceptance, change control, and dependency-based forecast.

milestones.title: M1 Base Contract Runtime and Deployment
milestones.description: WP-1 protocol and deployment correction: current Base contract, buyer-authorized inspection acceptance, governance rotation and quorum, role separation, canonical deployment, mandatory verification, and contract-cohort rollback.

milestones.title: M2 Base Eventing, Reconciliation, and Treasury Safety
milestones.description: WP-2 through WP-4 financial integrity: durable transaction outcomes, signer binding, durable queues, indexer completeness, bidirectional reconciliation, canonical treasury ingestion, maker-checker controls, and external handoff truth.

milestones.title: M3 Backend, Gateway, and Wallet Continuity
milestones.description: WP-9 cross-repository continuity: pinned Agroasys backend, platform.v1, Cotsel-Dash, Cotsel services, contract and provider identities; hosted compatibility; session, wallet, settlement, callback, status, dispute, treasury, support, and recovery journeys.

milestones.title: M4 Base Sepolia Pilot Readiness
milestones.description: WP-5 through WP-11 Base Sepolia readiness: migration and recovery, build and supply chain, production-like cloud, observability, operations, security and compliance assurance, engineering rehearsals, and controlled-pilot authorization.

milestones.title: M5 Base Mainnet Launch and Polkadot Retirement
milestones.description: WP-12 separate Base mainnet authorization: mainnet contract and application release, signer and provider capacity, treasury and off-ramp controls, cohort rollback, live-money drills, independent assurance, and four-role explicit approval.
